shared_qualification_notes: Eligibility explanation: These are Ekurhuleni West TVET College Occupational Ministerial Programmes. Published entry grades and subjects are minimum requirements and do not guarantee admission.

Academic requirement: Where Mathematics is listed as a requirement, Mathematical Literacy applicants are placed on a waiting list and may only be considered with a higher mark after all qualifying Mathematics applicants have been evaluated.

Academic requirement: For Grade 9 / NQF Level 1 programmes that require Mathematics and Science, Science is not a separate Grade 9 subject, so the published requirement is Mathematics and Technology. Grade 10 and Grade 11 applicants for those programmes are assessed on Mathematics and Science.

Academic requirement: Minimum Mathematics / Mathematical Literacy marks: NQF Level 1 / Grade 9 Mathematics 30%; NQF Level 2 / Grade 10 Mathematics 30% and Mathematical Literacy 40%; NQF Level 3 / Grade 11 Mathematics 30% and Mathematical Literacy 40%; NQF Level 4 / Grade 12 Mathematics 40% and Mathematical Literacy 50%.
Academic requirement: The minimum mark for English on all NQF levels / grades is 40%.
Source note: Official EWC Occupational Ministerial Programmes Admission Requirements (7 November 2025).
